what.text: This page follows refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina living in the Netherlands, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1060 refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina in the Netherlands, 4.3% of all refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Serbia and Kosovo is the largest host of refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina, followed by France and Denmark.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflicts in Bosnia-Herzegovina from 1992 to 1995, over Serb, Croat and Bihaca Krajina territory.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1995 to 2004, begin in the last year of those conflicts.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1993 at 4668 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 24556, at the end of 2002, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Netherlands.
These are year-end totals for the Netherlands only, reported to UNHCR.
